parsed.summary: The patch attempts to use fallback keys for session authentication, but it may not handle all cases correctly.

issues.description: The patch does not handle cases where all fallback keys are invalid or unavailable. It should return a default value or raise an exception in such scenarios.
The code could be more readable by using a list comprehension or a loop with a more descriptive variable name.
